situations.title: 금식 시작 시각 확인
situations.tagline: I had a light dinner last night, but I did have some water this morning — is that okay?
situations.brief: 고형식과 수분의 금식 시간을 구분해 환자에게 정확히 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: When did you last eat any solid food?
Water is a bit different — when did you have your last sip?
That timing looks fine, so we can go ahead as planned.
goals: 고형식과 수분 금식 시간을 각각 확인한다

situations.title: 약물 알레르기 문진
situations.tagline: Penicillin gives me a rash, but I'm not sure if that counts as a real allergy.
situations.brief: 알레르기 반응의 유형과 중증도를 구체적으로 청취하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you tell me what happens when you take penicillin?
Was it just a rash, or any trouble breathing or swelling?
I'll flag this in your chart so the whole team knows.

situations.title: 과거 수술·마취 이력
situations.tagline: I had my gallbladder out years ago and I was really nauseous when I woke up.
situations.brief: 이전 마취 경험과 부작용 여부를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: How did you feel waking up from your last anesthesia?
Did you have any nausea, breathing issues, or a bad reaction?
I'll let the anesthesia team know about the nausea.
goals: 마취 관련 위험 정보를 팀에 전달한다

situations.title: 복용 약물 목록 확인
situations.tagline: I take something for blood pressure and a couple of vitamins every day.
situations.brief: 상시 복용 중인 처방약과 용량을 파악하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you list all the medications you take daily?
Do you know the names and doses?
Did you take your blood pressure pill this morning?

situations.title: 기저 활력징후 측정
situations.tagline: My heart's been racing a little — I think I'm just nervous about all this.
situations.brief: 수술 전 기저 활력징후를 측정해 기록하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm going to check your vitals to get a baseline.
Your numbers look good for right now.
A little nervousness is completely normal before surgery.

situations.title: 키·체중·BMI 확인
situations.tagline: I'm about five-six, and I honestly haven't weighed myself in a while.
situations.brief: 약물 용량 산정을 위한 실제 키와 체중을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's get an accurate weight for your medication dosing.
Can you step on the scale for me?
This helps us give you the exact right dose.
goals: 용량 기준이 되는 실제 체중을 측정한다

situations.title: 물 한 모금 금식 위반
situations.tagline: I forgot and took my pill with a sip of water — is my surgery going to be canceled?
situations.brief: 금식 위반 내용을 확인해 보고하고 지연 여부 판단을 도우세요.
keyPhrases: Exactly how much water did you have, and at what time?
I need to report this to the anesthesia team.
They'll decide if we adjust the timing to keep you safe.
goals: 금식 위반 내용과 시각을 정확히 파악한다

situations.title: 조영제·해산물 교차 알레르기
situations.tagline: I'm allergic to shellfish — doesn't that mean I can't get the contrast dye?
situations.brief: 조영제와 해산물 알레르기의 교차 위험 오해를 사정하고 정리하세요.
keyPhrases: Shellfish allergy doesn't actually predict a contrast reaction.
But tell me exactly what happens with shellfish.
I'll document this and confirm the plan with the team.
goals: 해산물과 조영제 알레르기의 실제 위험을 사정한다

situations.title: 이전 마취 오심 병력
situations.tagline: Last time I threw up for hours after surgery — I really don't want that again.
situations.brief: PONV 고위험 여부를 선별해 예방 계획에 반영하세요.
keyPhrases: That sounds like PONV, and we can plan ahead for it.
I'll flag you as high-risk for post-op nausea.
The team can add medication to prevent it this time.
goals: 예방 계획 반영을 위해 팀에 공유한다

situations.title: 수면무호흡 병력
situations.tagline: My wife says I stop breathing in my sleep, and I use a CPAP machine at night.
situations.brief: 수면무호흡 병력으로 기도 위험을 선별하세요.
keyPhrases: Do you use your CPAP every night, and what pressure setting?
This matters a lot for your airway during anesthesia.
Did you bring your CPAP machine with you today?

situations.title: 심·호흡 기저질환
situations.tagline: I've got COPD and I had a stent put in my heart two years ago.
situations.brief: 심장·호흡기 기저질환을 파악해 마취 위험 인자를 정리하세요.
keyPhrases: Tell me more about your COPD and how your breathing is day to day.
Are you on any blood thinners since your stent?
I'll make sure anesthesia has your full cardiac history.

situations.title: 한약·건강보조제 복용
situations.tagline: I take fish oil and some herbal supplements — those don't really count, right?
situations.brief: 비처방 보조제의 출혈 위험을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Supplements actually do matter — some affect bleeding.
When did you last take the fish oil and herbs?
I'll list these so surgery knows about the bleeding risk.

situations.title: 흡연·음주력 문진
situations.tagline: I smoke about a pack a day and I'll have a few beers on the weekend.
situations.brief: 흡연·음주력이 회복과 마취에 미칠 영향을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: When did you have your last cigarette and last drink?
This helps us plan for your airway and recovery.
I'm not judging — I just need an honest picture.
goals: 흡연·음주 정도와 최근 사용 시점을 파악한다

situations.title: 가임기 임신 가능성
situations.tagline: There's no way I'm pregnant, so do I really need to do that test?
situations.brief: 가임기 여성의 임신 가능성을 확인해 검사 필요성을 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: It's a routine safety test for everyone who could be pregnant.
Anesthesia can affect a pregnancy, so we always confirm.
This stays confidential between you and the care team.

situations.title: 최근 상기도 감염
situations.tagline: I've had a cough and a runny nose for a few days — is it still safe to do this today?
situations.brief: 최근 상기도 감염 증상을 확인해 마취 연기 판단 근거를 마련하세요.
keyPhrases: When did the cough and congestion start?
Any fever, or coughing up any colored mucus?
I need anesthesia to weigh in before we proceed.
goals: 상기도 감염 증상과 발현 시점을 확인한다
마취 연기 판단을 위해 팀에 보고한다

situations.title: 응급 환자 금식 위반
situations.tagline: The patient ate a full meal an hour before the accident, so we're treating this as a full stomach.
situations.brief: 응급 환자의 full stomach 흡인 위험에 대비해 신속 유도를 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: We should treat this as a full stomach — RSI it is.
I have suction on and ready at the head of the bed.
Cricoid pressure is ready whenever you call for it.
goals: full stomach 흡인 위험을 팀과 공유한다

situations.title: 조영제 아나필락시스 병력
situations.tagline: I nearly died from contrast dye once — my throat closed right up and they had to give me a shot.
situations.brief: 중증 조영제 알레르기 병력을 확인해 아나필락시스 대비를 마련하세요.
keyPhrases: That's a serious reaction — I'm marking you as high-risk.
We'll have epinephrine and emergency meds ready.
The whole team will know before anything is given.
goals: 중증 조영제 알레르기 병력을 상세히 확인한다

situations.title: 원인 미상 약물 반응
situations.tagline: I don't know what it was, but something they gave me before made me swell up and dizzy.
situations.brief: 원인 미상 약물 반응을 확인해 즉시 대응 계획을 세우세요.
keyPhrases: Let's figure out everything you were given around that time.
Until we know, we'll avoid the likely culprits.
I'll have emergency meds on standby just in case.
goals: 미상 약물 반응의 정황과 증상을 최대한 파악한다

situations.title: 마취 가족력 MH 의심
situations.tagline: My brother had a really bad reaction under anesthesia — his temperature spiked and it was an emergency.
situations.brief: 가족력을 확인해 악성 고열(MH) 위험을 선별하세요.
keyPhrases: That could be malignant hyperthermia — very important to know.
Do you know if anyone else in the family had this?
I'll alert anesthesia so they can plan a safe technique.

situations.title: 항응고제 복용 미확인 도착
situations.tagline: I take a blood thinner every morning, but nobody told me to stop it before today.
situations.brief: 항응고제 복용 여부를 긴급 확인해 출혈 위험을 재평가하세요.
keyPhrases: Which blood thinner is it, and when was your last dose?
This changes your bleeding risk, so I need to report it now.
The team will decide whether to delay or proceed safely.
goals: 항응고제 종류와 최종 복용 시점을 긴급 확인한다
출혈 위험 재평가를 위해 팀에 즉시 보고한다

situations.title: 금식 확인 불가 무의식
situations.tagline: He came in unconscious, so we have no way to confirm when he last ate.
situations.brief: 금식 여부를 확인할 수 없는 무의식 환자에 대해 응급 흡인 대비를 하세요.
keyPhrases: We can't confirm NPO status, so assume a full stomach.
Suction is set up and I'm ready for RSI.
Let's have the airway cart right here at the bedside.
goals: 미상 금식 상태를 full stomach로 간주해 대비한다
